jurisdiction: City of Portland, Oregon (USA), Bureau of Development Services Administrative Appeal Board; non-Alberta comparative record

facts.text: Item 1 requests a non-combustible exterior wall with two layers of 5/8-inch fire-rated gypsum on the interior, a 2-hour interior-side-only assembly, citing City Type III Code Guide 1.b and OSSC 2014 104.11.
Item 2 requests one ADA unisex toilet room for a residential amenity space in place of the calculated fixtures, with the applicant rounding a 1.01 fixture load down.
Item 2 decision: reduction in minimum required plumbing fixtures in common-use spaces is denied because the proposal does not provide equivalent sanitary facilities.
Item 3 requests omission of an enclosed passageway from the stair or exit to a fire-pump room; the design provides a 2-hour enclosure around the pump room at grade.
Item 3 decision: omission of the exit passageway is granted as proposed.
